description: Na₂(ReS₂)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.78-3.21 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.32 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.34 Å. There are three inequivalent Re sites. In the first Re site, Re is bonded to five S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ReS₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Re-S bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.50 Å. In the second Re site, Re is bonded to five S atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ReS₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Re-S bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.48 Å. In the third Re site, Re is bonded to five S atoms to form ReS₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramid and edges with four ReS₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Re-S bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.43 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Re atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Re atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted pentagonal planar geometry to two Na and three Re atoms. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Re atoms to form distorted SNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₃Re₂ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramid, edges with two SNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramid. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to three Na and two Re atoms to form distorted SNa₃Re₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramid, edges with two SNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramid. In the sixth S site, S is bonded to two Na, one Re, and one S atom to form distorted SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ReS₅ square pyramid, corners with two SNa₂Re₃ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one SNa₂ReS trigonal pyramid, and edges with two SNa₃Re₂ trigonal bipyramids. The S-S bond length is 2.10 Å.
